nonblockingLimits: This approves the complete work plan and acceptance criteria, not future artwork, successful timing or a nine score.

My review has inspected source, numeric samples and frame sheets; I have not yet inspected continuous normal-speed playback. Performance scoring remains null until the relevant evidence supports an individual judgment.
No human comprehension, association or recall results are available. Owner preference, craft review and human findings must remain separately reported.
rationale: I read the entire proposal and score policy and verified the proposal hash. P1 gives attention a meaningful subject; P2 separates response, pause, reveal and settlement from total duration, evaluates the full mischievous joke separately from its static fallback, and treats pre-contact compression as a legitimate choice. The one-peek audition is useful exploration rather than a predetermined replacement for the two-peek control. P3–P5 preserve legibility, operability and rendered integrity without making technical success artistic proof. P6 preserves individual scores, dissent and evidence limits. Retaining a successful baseline is explicitly valid.

pairPosition.previousObjection: The pair proposal allowed alternatives only after demonstrating a failing beat.
pairPosition.resolution: The team principles explicitly permit reversible artistic alternatives even when the baseline works and require a named observed benefit with no unacceptable regression for adoption. P2 applies that rule to timing alternatives without requiring a prior defect. This fully resolves my failure-only prerequisite objection for the exact hashed team proposal.
pairPosition.acceptedScope: I endorse this complete team plan unchanged. The earlier pair objection remains a historical record and is superseded on this point by the team proposal; it is not an objection to implementation under this plan.
